title: On divergences in a four-derivative scalar field theory
source_statements: The perfect-square form is preserved under renormalisation.
The beta-function relation to O(2) phi^4 at negative coupling holds to all orders and is checked explicitly through three loops.
The positive Euclidean action makes the theory amenable to non-perturbative lattice studies.
A lattice continuum limit is proposed for investigation; it is not established in the source.
